Name: Game / Host Port
Description: Main game/host traffic (server.cfg hostPort). Must be forwarded for players to join.

Name: Steam Query Port
Description: Steam server query (server.cfg queryPort). Must be forwarded for the server to appear in the browser.

Name: Steam Port
Description: Steam communication (server.cfg steamPort). Must be forwarded for players to join.

Name: HTTP API Port
Description: HTTP/JSON admin API and web UI (server.cfg httpApiPort). Admin only - do NOT forward publicly.
